# Vintorex Digital Solutions: services, prices and FAQs

Vintorex Digital Solutions is a digital agency in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. It sells 21 websites, marketing, branding, cloud and AI services with published prices in INR (excluding 18% GST), each in three packages.
Address: 38 Bankers Colony Phase 2, Cheran Ma Nagar, Coimbatore 641035. Phone: +91 866 720 9838. Email: vintorexdigital@gmail.com. Prices reviewed October 2026.

## General FAQs
Q: What does Vintorex Digital Solutions do?
A: Vintorex Digital Solutions is a digital agency in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. It offers 21 services with published prices: build (websites, stores and apps); grow (seo, social and paid ads); brand & content (identity, content and video); cloud & data (hosting, cloud and analytics); ai & automation (chatbots, voice agents and automation).

Q: Where is Vintorex Digital Solutions located?
A: 38 Bankers Colony Phase 2, Cheran Ma Nagar, Coimbatore 641035, India. Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/Z5dYBa4UCpSNU6m99

Q: How do I contact Vintorex?
A: Call +91 866 720 9838, WhatsApp https://wa.me/918667209838, or email vintorexdigital@gmail.com.

Q: How much do Vintorex services cost?
A: Prices start from ₹999 and are listed in rupees on every service page, excluding 18% GST. Each service has three packages, and monthly services are billed per month.

Q: Does Vintorex charge GST?
A: Yes. Prices exclude 18% GST, which is added at checkout and shown on a GST invoice that can be used for input tax credit.

Q: Which payment methods are accepted?
A: UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), RuPay, Visa and Mastercard cards, and net banking.

Q: Can I pay in instalments?
A: Yes. One-time projects of ₹10,000 or more can be paid in milestones: 40% advance to start work, 40% mid-project approval, 20% delivery & handover.

Q: Is there a free website and SEO audit?
A: Yes. Vintorex offers a free 15-point audit covering site speed and Core Web Vitals, local SEO and Google Business Profile, competitor keyword gaps, and social and paid ads quick wins. Request it at https://vintorex.com/#audit.

Q: Does Vintorex offer membership plans?
A: Yes: Basic (free), Premium Growth (₹19,999 per month), Elite Scale (₹44,999 per month). Paid plans include discounts on one-time services.

Q: Does Vintorex offer AI and automation services?
A: Yes. The AI & Automation category covers AI Chatbot & WhatsApp Assistant, AI Voice Agent (Calls), Business Process Automation, AI Content & Creative Studio, Custom AI Assistant & Knowledge Base, AI Consulting & Team Training, AI Search Optimisation (GEO).
